rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Acidity order: HCOOH > CH3COOH > substituted... EWG (Cl, NO2) raise acidity by −I; EDG (alkyl) lower it; Cl3CCOOH >> CH3COOH — the inductive argument is the mark.  ·  Trick 2: Higher b.p. than alcohols: cyclic DIMERS via double H-bonding — quote 'dimerisation' for the physical-property mark.
